# Run book: Explore the examples

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/explore-the-examples.md) | [Spec](../specs/explore-the-examples.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)

## Purpose

One place to confirm every example endpoint is alive and to jump to the API and event references, before you start coding against them.

## Preconditions

- The example stack is running (see the deployment guide).

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Explore the examples"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/`:

1. **Open the overview.** The overview lists every example endpoint and checks that each one answers. Expect: The page title reads "OoBDev framework examples". Every probed endpoint shows OK.
2. **Pick a feature from the left navigation.** The navigation groups the examples by area. Choosing an entry opens its screen in the main blade and updates the breadcrumb. Expect: The breadcrumb shows Home > AI > Embeddings.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| An endpoint shows a red status | The API container is not running or still starting | Run `scripts/examples/example-up.ps1`, wait for healthy, press Check again |
| Every endpoint answers 0 | The browser cannot reach the API through the SPA proxy | Open http://localhost:8088 (not the Vite port) or check `docker compose ps` |

Related framework features: OoBDev.Example.WebApi; OoBDev.AspNetCore.Mvc (OpenAPI and AsyncAPI documents).
